slides.title: Tambat
lines: Bitcoin Cash and Nostr identity binding

slides.title: Tambat
lines: Prove that a Bitcoin Cash address and a Nostr key belong to the same person, and let anyone check it without trusting a server.

items.text: Open tambat.sasateguh.com/judges. It looks up the demo identity on public relays and shows every check passing.
Look up demo@tambat.sasateguh.com and press Try tampering. Each edit to a local copy is caught by a named step.
Open Demo app and sign in with a BCH wallet only. The server finds the Nostr key from the binding on its own.
A Nostr npub and a BCH address often belong to the same person, but neither network can say so.
NIP-39 lets a Nostr key claim outside identities. Tambat adds a bch platform: the BCH key signs the npub, the Nostr key signs the event that carries that signature.
The binding lives on ordinary public relays. A web page, the command line or one HTML file checks both signatures locally.
Look-up both ways, npub to address and address to npub: 1.1 to 2.4 seconds across public relays.
Signed with a Paytaca wallet over WalletConnect: event d7c03eee...489b verifies from two of three relays.
items.measured: 2026-11-17: a binding signed with a Paytaca wallet over WalletConnect

items.text: Sign in with a BCH wallet only: the server found the bound npub on its own relays.
Revoke or move a binding: afterwards the old address finds no npub.
Nine named checks. On the wall, 2 of 34 relay events naming a BCH address passed every one, and only those are shown.
BCH signed messages in the format wallets such as Electron Cash use, checked against third-party test vectors.
CashAddr P2PKH addresses, with the network checked so a testnet address cannot pass as mainnet.
Paytaca over WalletConnect bch_signMessage, or a signature pasted from any wallet.
Pay a person by npub or NIP-05 name: a BIP21 link and QR code for an address they proved. Your own wallet sends.
No transaction is needed to bind, look up or sign in.
A wallet that holds a BIP39 phrase can derive a Nostr key (NIP-06) and publish the binding in one step. The wallet guide shows the code.
Apps sign people in with keys they already hold, and pay them at addresses they proved.
Next: recovery of a lost Nostr key with the bound BCH key, and more than one address per person.
